name: io.github.fatihbaltaci/godrop
title: GoDrop
description: Self-hosted file host: upload a file, get a public URL an agent can paste into a pull request.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open, which is the whole transport.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: The process holds no state, so nothing is left behind.

packageArguments.description: Serve MCP on stdin and stdout instead of starting a server.

environmentVariables.name: GODROP_URL
environmentVariables.description: The base URL of the GoDrop you host, such as https://files.example.com.

environmentVariables.name: GODROP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An API token from that instance: godrop token create --name mcp.
